summary: Stores integer argument a3 into one of three per-group alpha/scale factor fields (0x14, 0x24, 0x34) selected by selector a2 (1, 2, or 3), then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup to refresh the DirectX vertex buffer texture coordinates from this+0x4, and finally sets the 0x800 dirty flag in the UI root context pointed to by dword_8B8F28. Called by sub_4FCEE0 and sub_55A500.

local_names.a2: selector 1/2/3 choosing which alpha/scale group is written
local_names.a3: integer value stored into the selected alpha/scale factor field

operations.description: Switch on selector a2: case 1 selects group 1 (offset 0x14), case 2 selects group 2 (offset 0x24), case 3 selects group 3 (offset 0x34); no write occurs for any other value
When a2 == 1 store a3 into this[5] (offset 0x14), the alpha/scale factor for group 1
When a2 == 2 store a3 into this[9] (offset 0x24), the alpha/scale factor for group 2
When a2 == 3 store a3 into this[13] (offset 0x34), the alpha/scale factor for group 3

Call DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup with the global device/context dword_8B78A0, this pointer, this[1] (offset 0x4, read-only vertex buffer identifier), and the mode derived from the selected group (2, 3, or 4) to refresh texture coordinates
Set the 0x800 dirty flag in the UI root context at dword_8B8F28 by OR-ing it into the DWORD at offset 236 of that context
Return dword_8B8F28 (the UI root context pointer)
Invoked by sub_4FCEE0 (004FCEE0) and sub_55A500 (0055A500) to set an alpha/scale factor and refresh the vertex buffer

clean_pseudocode: case 1: this[5] = a3;  DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup(dword_8B78A0, this, this[1], 2); break;
case 2: this[9] = a3;  DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup(dword_8B78A0, this, this[1], 3); break;
case 3: this[13] = a3; DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup(dword_8B78A0, this, this[1], 4); break;
